---
title: Snippet tester self-test (passing)
---

Temporary sample snippets for the snippet tester's own tests. They run
real bronto commands against the docs mock and must stay green.

```console test
$ bronto datasets list -o table
COLLECTION  DATASET           LAST_ACTIVITY  LOG_ID
prod        checkout-service  2m ago         0b7c6f2e-1d4a-4c8e-9a51-3f2d8e6b7a10
...
staging     checkout-service  5h ago         c3a8e5d2-9f4b-4e1a-a7c3-6b2d8f1e4c43
```

A pipe into jq, and a command that only has to succeed:

```console test
$ bronto search "status >= 500" -d prod/checkout-service --since 1h -o json | jq length
13
$ bronto ping -o json | jq -r .base_url
https://api.eu.bronto.io
$ bronto send -d checkout-service --collection staging -m "deploy finished"
```

<Steps>

1. An indented block with an expected failure exit code:

   ```console test exit=2
   $ bronto search "status >= 500" -d checkout-service
   ```

</Steps>

`test tty` puts stdout on a pseudo-terminal, so bronto prints its terminal default (a
table) without `-o`, while a pipe inside the command still sees a pipe:

```console test tty
$ test -t 1 && echo stdout is a terminal
stdout is a terminal
$ bronto collections list
COLLECTION  DATASETS  NAMES
prod        3         checkout-service, payments-api, web-frontend
staging     1         checkout-service
$ bronto collections list | jq -r '.[0] | keys[]'
prod
staging
```

Without `tty`, stdout is a pipe:

```console test
$ test -t 1 || echo stdout is a pipe
stdout is a pipe
```
